title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Timer T3590
entities.description: Timer used during PDU session authentication and authorization procedure. On fifth expiry, the SMF aborts the procedure.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message transmitted by SMF during PDU session authentication and authorization procedure.

entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure for authenticating and authorizing a PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to release a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request release of a PDU session.

entities.name: Collision of procedures
entities.description: Condition when UE-requested PDU session release procedure overlaps with PDU session authentication and authorization procedure for same PDU session.

entities.name: Abort authentication procedure
entities.description: SMF behavior to abort PDU session authentication and authorization procedure.

relations.description: SMF starts timer T3590 during PDU session authentication and authorization procedure.
SMF resets timer T3590 on first expiry during retransmission.
PDU session authentication and authorization procedure includes sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
Collision condition establishes the behavior to abort authentication procedure.
Receipt of PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message during authentication procedure creates collision condition.
UE-requested PDU session release procedure includes receiving PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message.
